summary:
[HEARTBEAT] Perform system health check and auto-stabilization:
1. Check if OpenClaw gateway is running (listening on port 18789). If not, start it.
2. Check for zombie node.exe processes using port 18789; kill any found.
3. Check for stale lock file at .openclaw-state/openclaw.lock; delete it if present.
4. Verify all critical agents (pluto, coder, social, osint, generalist) are responsive; if any are stuck, restart them.
5. Check all active subagent tasks: if any have been running longer than their ETA (or >30 minutes by default), report to user with task details.
6. Report a brief summary of actions taken (or "All systems stable") to this chat.
Execute quietly without asking questions.
